problem: Aiko is bringing jars of paint to the art room. Her teacher says the jars are packed in 4 crates with 6 jars in each crate. How many jars of paint is Aiko bringing?
follow_up_questions: On the way, three jars tip over and crack. How many of Aiko's jars are not cracked?
The school orders new jars to replace the cracked ones, plus 9 extra jars. How many jars does the school order?
The new jars are delivered in boxes of 4. How many boxes come?

problem: How many seed packets is Tomasz hauling to the garden shed if he has 4 sacks and every sack holds 6 packets?
follow_up_questions: Three of the packets tear open and the seeds spill out. How many of Tomasz's packets are still sealed?
The shop sends new packets: enough to replace the torn ones and 9 more. How many packets does the shop send?
The new packets come in bundles of 4. How many bundles arrive?

problem: Coach Ruiz is setting up 7 picnic blankets for the school picnic and wants 4 cushions on each one. Amaya offers to carry the cushions. How many cushions does she need to carry?
follow_up_questions: Amaya has already carried 19 cushions. How many more cushions must she carry?
She can take 3 cushions on each trip. How many more trips does she have to make?

problem: How many lanterns must Wen hang if the garden party has 7 trees and the host wants 4 lanterns in every tree?
follow_up_questions: So far Wen has hung 19 lanterns. How many lanterns does she still need to hang?
She can carry 3 lanterns up the ladder at a time. How many more climbs must she make?

problem: The school cook is making twenty-three trays of lasagne for the fair, and each tray needs 14 spoonfuls of tomato sauce. How many spoonfuls of sauce does she need?
follow_up_questions: Each can of tomato sauce holds 46 spoonfuls. How many cans will she open?
There are 3 cans in her kitchen already. How many more cans must she fetch from the store cupboard?

problem: Rafael's bakery has 23 big cakes to frost today. What amount of frosting does he need, in spoonfuls, if every cake gets 14 spoonfuls?
follow_up_questions: A tub of frosting holds 46 spoonfuls. How many tubs will Rafael use?
He already has 3 tubs on the counter. How many more tubs must he bring up from the cellar?

problem: Noor is planting seeds in 8 flower pots on the balcony, putting two seeds in each pot. Her cat is asleep in the sun. How many seeds does she plant?
follow_up_questions: The seed packet held 30 seeds. How many seeds are still in the packet?
She fills more pots with 2 seeds each until the packet is empty. How many more pots does she fill?
How many flower pots has she planted in altogether?

problem: What is the number of candles Bastian needs? He is decorating 8 small cakes for a party, and each cake gets two candles. Outside, it has started to snow.
follow_up_questions: The candle box had 30 candles in it. How many candles are left in the box?
He decorates more cakes with 2 candles each until the box is empty. How many more cakes does he decorate?
Counting all of them, how many cakes has Bastian decorated?

problem: Yara is setting up for her school's spring fair, which starts at 4 o'clock. She plans to put 24 cupcakes on each of her 6 plates. How many cupcakes will be on the plates?
Find how many stickers Ibrahim will hand out to the children in Room 4. He has 6 sheets, and each sheet holds 24 stickers.
The library's reading club has 5 tables for story time, and 6 children can sit at each table. How many children can join story time?
follow_up_questions: So far, 21 children have signed up. How many places are left?
Grandparents take the free places, and each one brings 2 books to share. How many books do the grandparents bring?

problem: How many runners can sign up for the relay if the coach has made 5 teams with room for 6 runners on each team?
follow_up_questions: Already 21 runners have put their names down. How many spots are still open?
Teachers fill the open spots, and each teacher brings 2 water bottles. Find the number of water bottles the teachers bring.

problem: Mr. Osei and his 4 helpers are making puppets for a show. Each of the 7 puppets needs 3 buttons. How many buttons are needed in all?
follow_up_questions: They have sewn on 16 buttons so far. How many buttons still need to be sewn on?

problem: What is the total number of flags for sports day? The field has 7 lanes, and the teacher wants 3 flags along each lane. The races start at 4 in the afternoon.
follow_up_questions: The children have planted 16 flags so far. How many flags are still missing?

problem: Each toy truck has 6 wheels, and the toy shop has 9 trucks on its shelf. The shop opened 12 years ago. How many wheels are on the trucks altogether?
follow_up_questions: The shopkeeper puts new wheels on 4 of the trucks. How many new wheels does he use?
New wheels come in bags of 8. How many bags does he open?

problem: How many legs are there on all the insects? Ms. Ito's class keeps 9 beetles in a tank that is 12 inches long, and each beetle has 6 legs.
follow_up_questions: Ms. Ito draws 4 of the beetles on the board. How many legs does she draw?
She draws the legs in groups of 8, using a different colour for each group. How many colours does she use?

problem: Leila is packing cookies at the bakery, 15 cookies to a bag. She must have 40 bags done before the market opens. How many cookies does she need?
follow_up_questions: The oven bakes 50 cookies in each batch. How many batches must be baked?

problem: What is the total number of beads Dalia needs? She is making 40 bracelets for the craft fair, and each bracelet takes 15 beads.
follow_up_questions: Beads are sold in tubes of 50. How many tubes does Dalia use?

problem: A builder needs 32 sacks of cement for a new wall, and every sack weighs 25 kilograms. How many kilograms of cement go into the wall?
follow_up_questions: One sack tears and all of its cement is lost. How many kilograms of cement reach the wall?

problem: How many kilograms of soil does the gardener spread on the flower beds if she empties 32 bags and each bag holds 25 kilograms?
follow_up_questions: She drops one bag in the pond and loses all its soil. How many kilograms of soil end up on the beds?

problem: The librarian asks Jun to carry 9 boxes to the new reading room. Each box holds 12 packs, and each pack holds 8 bookmarks. How many bookmarks is Jun carrying?
How many eggs are on the truck? The farm worker has loaded 9 crates. There are 12 cartons in a crate and 8 eggs in a carton.
Each of the 24 bracelets Esi is making needs 18 beads. Her little sister is watching cartoons. How many beads does Esi need?
How many sequins will Mateo sew on? He has cut out 24 paper stars for the class banner and plans 18 sequins on each star. The banner will hang above the door.
Grandma bakes 5 pies for the family picnic and slices each pie into 6 pieces. How many pieces of pie are there?
What is the number of orange slices the coach brings to the match? She cuts each orange into 6 slices, and she has 5 oranges.
Ana is taking juice boxes to her soccer team. She buys 3 packs with 6 juice boxes in each pack. The grass at the field was just cut. How many juice boxes is she taking?
follow_up_questions: Her team has 20 players. If every player gets one juice box, how many more juice boxes does she need?

problem: How many pencils does Mr. Farouk have for his art class? He picks up 3 cases from the store, each holding 6 pencils. The store smells of new paper.
follow_up_questions: There are 20 pupils in his art class. If each pupil needs one pencil, how many more pencils must he find?

problem: Priya sold 42 sandwiches at her stall on Saturday, and every sandwich had 3 slices of cheese. How many slices of cheese did she use?
follow_up_questions: Cheese comes in packs of 18 slices. How many packs did she use up?
On Sunday she sold 9 fewer sandwiches than on Saturday. How many slices of cheese did she use on Sunday?

problem: How many nails did Kwame use on Saturday, when he built 42 birdhouses with 3 nails in each?
follow_up_questions: Nails come in boxes of 18. How many boxes did he empty?
On Sunday he built 9 fewer birdhouses than on Saturday. How many nails did he use on Sunday?

problem: Dad bought 5 packets of pancake mix for the class breakfast, and each packet makes 8 pancakes. His daughter Zara, who is 11, helps him cook. How many pancakes can they make?
follow_up_questions: The children eat 33 pancakes. How many pancakes are not eaten?
Zara and her dad eat 2 of those pancakes. How many uneaten pancakes are left now?

problem: How many paper cranes can the art group fold? Each pack of paper makes 8 cranes, the group has 5 packs, and there are 11 children in the group.
follow_up_questions: They hang 33 cranes from the ceiling. How many cranes are not hung up?
The teacher takes home 2 of the cranes that were not hung up. How many of those cranes are left?

problem: The class wants to sell 17 cakes an hour at the bake sale, and the sale runs for 8 hours. If the class hits its target, how many cakes will it sell?
follow_up_questions: By noon the class has sold 59 cakes. How many more must it sell to reach the target?
The class wants to sell those cakes evenly over the last 7 hours. How many cakes per hour is that?

problem: What is the target number of pages for the readathon, if the plan is 17 pages every hour for 8 hours?
follow_up_questions: After lunch, the readers have read 59 pages. How many pages are still needed to hit the target?
They want to read those pages evenly over the last 7 hours. How many pages per hour is that?

problem: The garden club is planting 26 window boxes, and every box needs 12 tulip bulbs. How many bulbs does the club need?
Work out how many beads Grandma Halina needs: she is decorating 26 belts for the dancers at the festival, and each belt gets 12 beads.
The swimming pool has 3 lanes for lessons, and each lane runs 4 lessons a day. How many lessons are there each day?
follow_up_questions: On Saturday, the pool adds 2 extra lessons. How many lessons are there on Saturday?
Sunday has as many lessons as Saturday. How many lessons are there over both days?

problem: How many tours run each day at the castle, if each of its 3 guides leads 4 tours a day?
follow_up_questions: On Saturday, 2 night tours are added. How many tours run on Saturday?
Sunday has the same number of tours as Saturday. What is the total for both days?

problem: Jonas and Pita want to paint 4 fences in the yard, each with 10 boards. How many boards will they paint?
follow_up_questions: They have painted 23 boards so far. How many boards are left to paint?
Pita paints 8 of the boards that are left. How many boards still need painting?
Each board takes 2 minutes to paint. How many minutes will the rest of the boards take?

problem: How many tiles go into the mosaic? Mrs. Kaur's art class is making 4 panels, and each panel needs 10 tiles.
follow_up_questions: The class has glued 23 tiles. How many tiles are still to be glued?
Mrs. Kaur glues 8 of those herself. How many tiles still need gluing?
Each tile takes 2 minutes to glue. How long will the remaining tiles take, in minutes?

problem: At the bakery, Sven packs muffins into boxes of 7. He has filled 6 boxes. How many muffins are in his boxes?
follow_up_questions: There are 13 more muffins on a tray. How many muffins does he have in all?
A customer buys 3 boxes. How many muffins are left in the bakery?

problem: How many crayons are in Amelie's packs? She has made 6 packs for the art table, putting 7 crayons in each.
follow_up_questions: She also has 13 loose crayons in a cup. How many crayons does she have altogether?
A classmate borrows 3 of the packs. What is the number of crayons left with Amelie?

problem: Each egg carton in the farm shop holds eggs in 3 rows of 4. Mrs. Lindqvist buys 2 full cartons. How many eggs does she buy?
follow_up_questions: She uses 9 eggs for a cake. How many eggs are left?

problem: How many chocolates are there in 2 boxes, if every box has its chocolates set out in 3 rows with 4 in each row?
follow_up_questions: Aunt Fatou eats 9 of the chocolates. How many chocolates remain?

problem: At the fruit stand, each bag holds 4 peaches. Mrs. Moreau buys 7 bags for a picnic. How many peaches does she buy?
follow_up_questions: She shares the peaches equally among 7 children. How many peaches does each child get?

problem: How many pancakes come to the table? The camp cook makes 7 stacks, with 4 pancakes in each stack.
follow_up_questions: The 7 campers share the pancakes equally. How many does each camper get?

problem: Mei stocks the school library shelf with 4 rows of picture books, 8 books in each row. The library clock ticks quietly. How many picture books does she put on the shelf?
follow_up_questions: Children borrow 17 of the books before lunch. How many books are left on the shelf?
Mei adds 5 more books. How many books are on the shelf now?

problem: How many jars of jam are on the shop's display? Gustav lined up 4 rows with 8 jars in each row. A bell rings when the door opens.
follow_up_questions: Shoppers buy 17 jars before noon. How many jars are left on display?
Gustav brings out 5 more jars. How many jars are on display now?

problem: Ruth is decorating 8 cupcakes for her son's party; he is turning 7 tomorrow. Each cupcake gets 5 strawberries on top. How many strawberries does she need?
follow_up_questions: She washed 46 strawberries. How many are extra?
She shares the extra strawberries equally on 2 more cupcakes. How many strawberries go on each of those cupcakes?
Counting the new ones, how many cupcakes does Ruth have now?

problem: How many buttons will Kemal sew? He is making 8 teddy bears for the market, which opens at 7, and every bear gets 5 buttons.
follow_up_questions: He bought 46 buttons. How many buttons are extra?
He shares the extra buttons equally on 2 more teddy bears. How many buttons does each of those bears get?
Counting the new bears, how many teddy bears has Kemal made?

problem: After his chess team wins 3 games in a row, Sanjay treats them to 7 hot dogs. There are 4 pickle slices on each hot dog. How many pickle slices is that?
follow_up_questions: Sanjay asks for 5 extra pickle slices for the coach. What is the total number of pickle slices now?

problem: How many cherries are on the cakes? Valentina's bakery made 7 cakes for a wedding that starts at 3 o'clock, and each cake has 4 cherries on top.
follow_up_questions: The bride asks for 5 extra cherries. How many cherries are there now?

problem: Tomas is selling candles at the craft market. He packs 12 boxes, with 25 candles in each box. How many candles does he take?
follow_up_questions: He sells 86 candles on the first day. How many candles are left?
On the second day he sells 99 more. Find how many candles remain.
He packs the remaining candles into bags of 5. How many bags does he fill?

problem: How many napkins is Grace taking to the street party? She has 12 bundles, with 25 napkins in each bundle.
follow_up_questions: Guests use 86 napkins in the afternoon. How many napkins are left?
In the evening they use 99 more. How many napkins are left now?
Grace folds the leftover napkins into stacks of 5. How many stacks does she make?

problem: At the bus stop there are 2 lines of children, with 6 children in each line. A squirrel runs up a nearby tree. How many children are waiting for the bus?
follow_up_questions: A small van can take 4 children at a time. How many trips will the van need to take them all?

problem: How many kayaks are waiting at the river? Ida counts 2 rows, each with 6 kayaks. The water sparkles in the sunshine.
follow_up_questions: The guides can launch 4 kayaks at a time. How many launches will it take to get them all on the water?

problem: Sana proudly tells her grandmother that she has sold every raffle card in 9 of her booklets. Each booklet has 5 raffle cards. How many raffle cards did she sell?
How many packs of cookies did the scouts sell if 9 scouts each sold a full carton and every carton holds 5 packs?
At the playground, Kwesi points out that every tricycle has 3 wheels. There are 7 tricycles by the sandpit. A kite is stuck in the oak tree. How many wheels are on the tricycles?
How many leaves are on the clovers Hana picked? She found 7 clovers, and each one has 3 leaves. The meadow was full of buzzing bees.
The museum tour has six rooms, and the guide spends 9 minutes in each room. Leo carries a little notebook. How many minutes does the tour spend in the rooms?
follow_up_questions: After the rooms, there is a 5 minute talk in the hall. How many minutes does the whole tour last?
Leo joins the tour 4 minutes late. How long, in minutes, is he on the tour?

problem: How many minutes will the songs take? The choir will sing 6 songs at the concert, each 9 minutes long. The hall has red velvet seats.
follow_up_questions: After the songs there is a 5 minute speech. How many minutes does the whole concert last?
Amira arrives 4 minutes late. How long, in minutes, is she at the concert?

problem: Each rowing boat at the lake holds 3 people, and there are 4 boats to rent. Ducks are paddling near the dock. What is the most people who can be out in the boats at the same time?
follow_up_questions: If 17 people are waiting to go out, how many must wait for the next turn?

problem: What is the greatest number of children who can ride the carousel at once, if it has 4 rows and 3 horses in each row? Music plays from a speaker.
follow_up_questions: If 17 children are lined up, how many will have to wait for the next ride?

problem: This morning the baker made 23 loaves and cut each one into 16 slices. How many slices of bread can he sell today?
How many tulips can the florist sell if she has tied 23 bunches with 16 tulips in each bunch?
Coach Petrova lays out the gear for 6 swimmers, and each swimmer gets 3 items: a cap, goggles and a towel. How many items does she lay out?
follow_up_questions: Two more swimmers join the practice. How many more items does the coach need?
How many items are laid out now?

problem: How many crayons does Mr. Tanaka hand out? He gives 3 crayons to each of the 6 children at the craft table.
follow_up_questions: Then 2 more children sit down at the table. How many more crayons does Mr. Tanaka need?
What is the number of crayons on the table now?

problem: In the school kitchen, the cook bakes 8 trays of rolls at once, with 5 rolls on each tray. How many rolls are in the oven at one time?
Find how many flowers are in the window display: the florist has put out 8 vases, and each vase holds 5 roses.
Sipho gets one stamp for every swimming lesson, and a full card earns him a medal. The card has boxes 5 across and 4 down. How many stamps does he need for the medal?
follow_up_questions: He already has 13 stamps. How many more does he need?
How many stamps would two full cards hold?

problem: How many stickers fill one page of Mina's sticker book? Each page has 5 spaces in a row, and there are 4 rows.
follow_up_questions: She has stuck 13 stickers on the page. How many more will fill it?
How many stickers would two full pages hold?

problem: On the first warm day of spring, 26 children went to the beach to build a sandcastle. Each child filled 5 buckets of sand. How many buckets of sand were filled?
follow_up_questions: The sandcastle used 98 of the buckets. How many buckets of sand were not used?
The spare buckets were shared equally among 4 groups to build small towers. How many buckets did each group get?

problem: How many paper chains did the class make for the hall? There are 26 children, and each child made 5 chains.
follow_up_questions: They hung 98 of the chains. How many chains were left over?
The leftover chains were shared equally among 4 classrooms. How many chains did each classroom get?

problem: A school trip to the museum took 3 hours. Each of the 7 groups bought 5 postcards in the gift shop. How many postcards were bought?
follow_up_questions: Every postcard came with 2 stamps. How many stamps were there in all?
On the bus home, 9 stamps were lost. How many stamps made it back to school?

problem: How many kites flew at the festival? There were 7 teams, every team brought 5 kites, and the wind blew for 3 hours.
follow_up_questions: Every kite had 2 tails. How many tails were there altogether?
By evening, 9 tails had blown away. How many tails were left on the kites?

problem: Each paper windmill has 4 blades. For the garden show, the craft club made 8 windmills; the club meets 15 times a year. How many blades did they make?
Find the total number of legs on the 8 new tables in the dining hall, where each table stands on 4 legs. The hall seats 15 families.
Mrs. Ndlovu's class is making 9 toy cars from boxes. Each car needs 4 bottle caps for wheels. How many bottle caps does the class need?
follow_up_questions: The class has already collected 20 bottle caps. How many more caps must they find?

problem: How many legs does a carpenter need for 9 stools if he builds each stool with 4 legs?
follow_up_questions: He has 20 legs already cut. How many more legs must he cut?

problem: There are two players at each of the 7 ping-pong tables in the gym. How many people are playing ping-pong?
How many dancers are on stage? The teacher has set them out in 7 groups, and there are 2 dancers in every group.
At the family reunion by the lake, the cousins slept in cabins: 3 cousins in each of the 6 cabins. The lake was perfectly still at dawn. What was the number of cousins sleeping in the cabins?
follow_up_questions: For breakfast, each cousin ate 2 pancakes. How many pancakes were eaten?

problem: How many sailors slept aboard? The fishing fleet had 6 boats in the harbour, and 3 sailors slept on each boat. Gulls cried over the docks all night.
follow_up_questions: At sunrise, every sailor drank 2 cups of tea. How many cups of tea were drunk?

problem: At the orchard, the class picked enough apples to fill 5 baskets with 9 apples in each. How many apples did they pick?
follow_up_questions: The next day the class filled 3 more baskets of the same size. How many apples did they pick over both days?
The farmer gives 1 sticker for every 8 apples picked. How many stickers did the class get?

problem: How many seashells did the children collect on the beach? They filled 5 buckets with 9 shells in each.
follow_up_questions: The next morning they filled 3 more buckets just like those. How many shells did they collect over the two mornings?
The beach shop gives 1 marble for every 8 shells. How many marbles could they get?

problem: The shelter cats get 6 scoops of food in each bowl, and the helpers filled 8 bowls this morning. How many scoops of food did they use?
follow_up_questions: The food bin held 60 scoops before feeding time. How many scoops are left in the bin?
The leftover food is shared equally among 3 new kittens. How many scoops does each kitten get?

problem: How many seeds were sown? Gardeners prepared 8 trays, and they sowed 6 seeds in each tray.
follow_up_questions: They had 60 seeds in the packet before sowing. How many seeds are left in the packet?
The leftover seeds are shared equally among 3 neighbours. How many seeds does each neighbour get?

problem: A parking garage has 16 levels, and each level has 9 spaces for bikes. How many bike spaces are there in the garage?
How many lockers line the school hallway? The janitor counts 16 stacks, and each stack is 9 lockers tall.
The cinema has 8 sofas in each of its 4 small screening rooms. Find the total number of sofas.
follow_up_questions: On Friday night, 19 of the sofas were taken. How many sofas were empty?
Then 6 more families came in and each took a sofa. How many sofas were still empty?

problem: How many seats are on the ferry's top deck if it has 4 benches with 8 seats each?
follow_up_questions: As the ferry left, 19 seats were filled. How many seats were free?
At the next stop, 6 more passengers sat down. How many seats were still free?

problem: There are 3 vans at the bakery, and each van carries 9 trays of bread. How many trays are on the vans?
follow_up_questions: The driver finds that 4 trays have squashed loaves. How many trays are in good shape?

problem: How many lifejackets are on the boats if the sailing school has 3 boats and keeps 9 lifejackets on each one?
follow_up_questions: The instructor finds that 4 lifejackets have broken straps. How many lifejackets are in good condition?

problem: Mr. Haddou wants to build stools, so he buys 6 bags of wooden legs at the craft shop. Each bag holds 4 legs. How many legs does he have?
follow_up_questions: Each stool needs 4 legs. How many stools can he build?
He keeps 2 stools and gives the rest to his neighbours. How many stools does he give away?
He also gives 3 cushions with each stool he gives away. How many cushions does he hand out?

problem: How many tyres does Rosa buy for her friends' go-karts? The garage sells tyres in sets of 4, and she buys 6 sets.
follow_up_questions: Every go-kart needs 4 tyres. How many go-karts can she fix?
Rosa keeps 2 of the go-karts and returns the rest to her friends. How many go-karts does she return?
With each returned go-kart she gives 3 stickers. How many stickers does she give away?

problem: Every child in the nature group painted 4 autumn leaves, and there are 9 children in the group. A few of the leaves were bright red. How many leaves were painted?
follow_up_questions: The teacher pinned the leaves on the wall in 6 equal rows. How many leaves were in each row?
Then she took down 2 rows to make room for a map. How many leaves were still on the wall?
Later the class pinned up 5 new leaves. How many leaves are on the wall now?

problem: How many paper hearts did the children make? There were 9 children, and each made 4 hearts for the hallway. The hallway smelled of fresh paint.
follow_up_questions: The hearts were taped to the door in 6 equal rows. How many hearts were in each row?
Then 2 rows were taken down to fit a sign. How many hearts stayed on the door?
Afterwards the children taped up 5 more hearts. How many hearts are on the door now?

problem: The music room had 5 mats, and Mr. Aziz placed 6 drums on every mat for his 28 pupils. How many drums did he place?
follow_up_questions: By the end of the lesson, 7 drums had a torn skin. How many drums were still fine?

problem: How many jars of glue did Ms Kowalski set out? On a cold day her class of 28 stayed in to make cards, and she placed 6 jars on each of the 5 tables.
follow_up_questions: By home time, 7 jars had dried out. How many jars were still usable?

problem: The art show has paintings of flowers by 7 pupils. Each pupil painted one flower with 8 petals. How many petals were painted altogether?
follow_up_questions: The teacher wants to put a dot of glitter on every petal. She has 60 glitter dots. How many dots will be left over?

problem: How many legs did the spider models have altogether? In the science club, 7 children each built a spider with 8 legs.
follow_up_questions: The club leader has 60 pipe cleaners and uses one for each leg. How many pipe cleaners are left over?

problem: Each of the 6 groups in the cooking class makes a fruit skewer with 7 grapes. The class lasts 45 minutes. How many grapes are used?
Calculate the total number of nails if 6 builders each hammer 7 nails into the fence. The fence is 45 metres long.
A box of crayons holds 32 crayons, and the art room has 3 full boxes. How many crayons are in the art room?
follow_up_questions: When the class counted the crayons, 5 were missing. How many crayons did they find?

problem: In the music room there are 3 full sets of bells. What is the total number of bells, if each set has 32?
follow_up_questions: After the concert, 5 bells could not be found. How many bells were put away?

problem: At the swimming gala, each of the 8 swimmers on the blue team won 3 ribbons. How many ribbons did the team win?
How many stars did the 8 pupils in Mr. Banda's reading group earn, if every pupil got 3 stars?
The beach is split into 6 sections, and the lifeguards put 4 bins in every section. What is the total number of bins on the beach?
follow_up_questions: Each bin was emptied 3 times over the weekend. How many emptyings were there in all?

problem: How many flower pots are on the hotel's balconies? The hotel has 6 balconies, and the gardener put 4 pots on every balcony.
follow_up_questions: Each pot was watered 3 times that week. How many waterings were there altogether?

problem: There were 12 yoghurts in every box, and the school canteen got 35 boxes. It took 4 cooks to stack them all in the fridge. How many yoghurts arrived?
How many eggs came to the bakery? The farmer delivered 35 trays with 12 eggs on each tray, and it took him 4 trips to carry them in.
At the garden shop, seed packets are tied in bundles of 10. Mr. Obi buys 7 bundles. How many seed packets does he buy?
follow_up_questions: He plants 25 packets in his allotment. How many packets does he have left?

problem: How many marbles does Chiara have in her 7 bags, if every bag holds 10 marbles?
follow_up_questions: She gives 25 marbles to her cousin. How many marbles does she have left?

problem: The librarian gave 2 bookmarks to each child who brought a book back on time. Today 23 children did. How many bookmarks did she hand out?
follow_up_questions: The librarian began the day with 60 bookmarks. How many bookmarks were left?

problem: How many balloons did the face painter hand out? At the fair, 23 children had their faces painted, and each one got 2 balloons.
follow_up_questions: The face painter had 60 balloons at the start. How many did she have left?

problem: The town festival puts up 3 marquees. Each marquee has 6 rows of seats, and each row seats 8 people. How many people can sit down?
How many passengers can the train carry? It has 3 carriages, each carriage has 6 compartments, and each compartment seats 8 passengers.
The park keeper pours 7 cans of water on each of the 18 flower beds on a dry summer day. The fountain was switched off for repairs. How many cans does she pour altogether?
follow_up_questions: Her big barrel fills 9 cans. How many barrels does she empty?

problem: How many scoops of feed does the farmer give his goats? He fills 18 troughs and puts 7 scoops in each trough. The barn roof is painted red.
follow_up_questions: One sack of feed holds 9 scoops. How many sacks does he use up?

problem: Lucia rings her bike bell 3 times at the busy crossing every time she rides to school. She rode to school on 5 days this week. How many times did she ring her bell?
follow_up_questions: Her brother rang his bell twice as many times. How many times did he ring it?

problem: How many times did Omar jump over the garden stream? He played outside on 5 afternoons and jumped over it 3 times each afternoon.
follow_up_questions: His cousin jumped over it twice as often. How many jumps did his cousin make?

problem: For its summer workshop with 40 children, the art club orders 9 boxes of paintbrushes. A box holds 15 brushes. How many paintbrushes does the club order?
How many tickets did the class buy? The museum sells tickets in strips of 15, and the teacher bought 9 strips for a trip that is 40 kilometres away.
The science room has 5 lamp kits on the top shelf, and every kit comes with 6 bulbs. The shelf is painted green. What is the total number of bulbs?
follow_up_questions: Each bulb needs 2 clips to hold it. How many clips does the class need?
The class has 45 clips. How many more clips must it get?
Clips come in bags of 5. How many bags must the class buy to get the missing clips?

problem: How many buttons are there in total? Each of the 5 jackets in the costume box has 6 buttons. The box smells of mothballs.
follow_up_questions: Each button needs 2 stitches to be sewn on again. How many stitches are needed?
Grandma has already sewn 45 stitches. How many more stitches must she sew?
She sews 5 stitches every minute. How many minutes will the missing stitches take?

problem: The teachers lay out desks for the school quiz: 4 desks in each row, and 9 rows in all. How many desks is that?
follow_up_questions: Two pupils share each desk. How many pupils can take part at once?

problem: How many canoes are lined up at the lake? The camp leader counts 9 rows, with 4 canoes in each row.
follow_up_questions: Each canoe holds 2 campers. How many campers can paddle at the same time?

problem: Gemma strings 48 beads on every necklace she makes. She wants to make 9 necklaces for the craft fair. How many beads does she need?
What number of bricks does the builder need for 9 garden walls, if every wall uses 48 bricks?
The school kitchen gets 15 crates of apples from a farm every week. Each crate holds 6 bags of apples. How many bags of apples arrive each week?
follow_up_questions: How many bags does the kitchen get in 4 weeks?
The kitchen gives the bags out to classes, 9 bags per class. How many classes get apples over those weeks?
Each of those classes also gets 2 jugs of juice. How many jugs of juice are given out?

problem: How many eggs reach the cafe each week? A farmer drops off 15 boxes every week, with 6 eggs in each box.
follow_up_questions: How many eggs reach the cafe in 4 weeks?
The cook uses 9 eggs for each big omelette. How many omelettes can she make with those eggs?
Each omelette is served with 2 slices of toast. How many slices of toast are served?

problem: The delivery driver has a stop at each of the 6 cafes around the town square, and he leaves 8 boxes at every cafe. The fountain in the square is splashing. What is the number of boxes he leaves at the cafes?
follow_up_questions: Each box weighs 2 kilograms. What is the total weight of the boxes?
After the cafes, his truck still holds 13 boxes for homes. How many boxes were in the truck at the start?

problem: How many letters does the mail carrier drop at the farms? She visits 6 farms, leaving 8 letters at each one. Her bike has a squeaky wheel.
follow_up_questions: Each letter has 2 stamps on it. How many stamps are there on these letters?
After the farms, her bag still holds 13 letters for the village. How many letters were in her bag at the start?

problem: The salon has 3 hairdressers. Before lunch, every one of them gives 8 haircuts. What is the number of haircuts given before lunch?
follow_up_questions: After lunch, each hairdresser gives 5 haircuts. How many haircuts are given after lunch?
How many haircuts are given across the whole day?
Each haircut takes 10 minutes. How many minutes do the hairdressers spend cutting hair in total?

problem: How many bikes are repaired before noon at the repair shop, where 3 mechanics each fix 8 bikes?
follow_up_questions: After noon, each mechanic fixes 5 more bikes. How many bikes are repaired after noon?
What is the number of bikes repaired over the whole day?
Each repair takes 10 minutes. How many minutes do the mechanics spend on repairs altogether?

problem: Each tractor on the farm has 6 lights. The farmers polish all of them on their 4 tractors, using 10 cloths. How many lights do they polish?
follow_up_questions: It takes 3 minutes to polish one light. How many minutes do they spend polishing lights?

problem: How many windows do the cleaners wash? There are 4 buses in the depot, each bus has 6 windows, and the cleaners use 10 sponges.
follow_up_questions: Washing one window takes 3 minutes. How long do they spend washing windows, in minutes?

problem: The playground has 5 hopscotch grids, each with 7 squares. Ayo wants to hop on all of them. How many squares are there to hop on?
follow_up_questions: He hops along every grid twice. How many squares does he hop on?

problem: How many rungs can the firefighter trainee climb? The training yard has 5 ladders, and each ladder has 7 rungs.
follow_up_questions: She climbs every ladder twice. How many rungs does she climb?

problem: At the water park, each of the 32 children went down a slide 9 times. The pool at the bottom was 2 metres deep. How many slide rides were there?
follow_up_questions: After lunch, each child went down 4 more times. How many rides were there after lunch?
How many rides were there in the whole day?
The rides were shared equally between the park's 2 slides. How many rides went down each slide?

problem: How many laps were swum? The pool was open from 2 o'clock, and 32 children each swam 9 laps.
follow_up_questions: After a break, each child swam 4 more laps. How many laps were swum after the break?
What is the total number of laps swum that day?
The laps were split equally between the 2 lanes of the pool. How many laps were swum in each lane?

problem: In the gym, the coach laid out 16 rows of hoops with 7 hoops in every row, while the 11 players warmed up. What was the total number of hoops?
follow_up_questions: Then the coach picked up 3 rows. How many hoops were left on the floor?

problem: How many chairs were set out for the school concert? The caretaker arranged 16 rows with 7 chairs per row, and it took him 11 minutes.
follow_up_questions: Then he stacked away 3 rows. How many chairs were still set out?

problem: Kalinda is making 7 bracelets for the fair, and every bracelet takes 36 beads. How many beads does she need?
follow_up_questions: She already has 5 tubs with 40 beads in each. How many more beads must she buy?
Beads are sold in packets of 4. How many packets must she buy?

problem: What is the number of nails a carpenter needs for 7 benches, if each bench takes 36 nails?
follow_up_questions: He already has 5 boxes with 40 nails in each. How many more nails must he buy?
Nails are sold in bags of 4. How many bags must he buy?

problem: Bilal has tennis practice for 6 weeks, and every week he plays 3 matches there. Find how many matches he plays.
follow_up_questions: He wins 11 of those matches. How many matches does he not win?
Of the matches he does not win, 4 are stopped by rain and never finished. How many does he lose?
His sister Leyla plays twice as many matches as Bilal in those weeks. How many matches does Leyla play?

problem: How many songs does Freya sing in 6 weeks, if she sings 3 songs at choir every week?
follow_up_questions: She sings 11 of them as a solo. How many songs does she not sing as a solo?
Of those, 4 are duets. How many does she sing with the whole choir?
Her friend Pavel sings twice as many songs as Freya in those weeks. How many songs does Pavel sing?

problem: For the school sale, the teachers filled 16 boxes with spare pencils, 25 pencils to a box. How many pencils did they pack?
follow_up_questions: Another school packed 9 boxes of the same size. How many pencils did the other school pack?
How many more pencils were in the first lot than in the second?

problem: How many sheets of card are on the art cupboard shelves? The teacher counts 16 stacks, and each stack has 25 sheets.
follow_up_questions: A second cupboard holds 9 stacks of the same size. How many sheets are in the second cupboard?
How many more sheets are in the first cupboard than in the second?

problem: There are 45 comics on every one of the library's 8 comic shelves. What is the total number of comics?
follow_up_questions: During the holiday sale, every comic on 4 of the shelves was sold. How many comics are still on the shelves?

problem: How many tins of paint are in the hardware shop's storeroom? There are 8 racks, with 45 tins on each rack.
follow_up_questions: On Saturday, customers bought all the tins on 4 of the racks. How many tins are left on the racks?

problem: Each of the 9 desks at the bank has a cup with 6 pencils, and 14 customers are waiting in line. How many pencils are on the desks?
follow_up_questions: By closing time, 17 pencils have gone missing. How many pencils are left?
The manager then puts 3 new pencils on each desk. How many pencils are there now?

problem: How many crayons are on the tables in the art room? There are 9 tables, each with a tub of 6 crayons, and the room has 14 windows.
follow_up_questions: After the lesson, 17 crayons are missing. How many crayons are left?
The teacher adds 3 new crayons to every table. How many crayons are there now?

problem: How many animal stickers did the zoo give away? It hands out 5 stickers to every birthday child, and 8 birthday children visited last month. The zoo has 12 keepers.
follow_up_questions: Each birthday child also got 2 pairs of animal socks. How many socks did the zoo give away?

problem: The school welcomes each new pupil with a pack of 5 crayons. This term there are 8 new pupils, and 12 teachers signed their welcome card. How many crayons are in the welcome packs?
follow_up_questions: Each pack also holds 2 pairs of gloves. How many gloves are in all the packs?

problem: There are 3 lights on the front of every tractor at the farm. The farm owns 4 tractors and 20 cows. How many front lights do the tractors have?
How many sails are there on the 4 boats in the harbour, if each boat has 3 sails? The harbour has 20 moorings.
The gymnastics show began 2 hours late because the lights broke. When it started, each of the 7 gymnasts performed 4 moves. How many moves were performed?
follow_up_questions: Each move was scored by 3 judges. How many scores did the judges give?
Twelve scores were the top mark. How many scores were below the top mark?
The scores below the top mark were written on cards, 8 scores to a card. How many cards were used?

problem: How many dives were made at the swimming gala? There were 7 divers, each one made 4 dives, and the gala finished at 2 o'clock.
follow_up_questions: Each dive was marked by 3 judges. How many marks were given?
Of those marks, twelve were perfect. What number of marks were not perfect?
The marks that were not perfect were listed on sheets, 8 marks per sheet. How many sheets were needed?

problem: Each of the 6 water troughs on the farm holds 85 litres after the 4 cows have had their morning drink. How many litres of water are in the troughs altogether?
How many litres of milk are there? A dairy fills 6 big churns with 85 litres each, and the milk truck arrives at 4 o'clock.
For the classroom wall, the children glued 10 paper flowers in each of 8 rows. How many flowers did they glue?
follow_up_questions: Then they took off 15 flowers that had torn. How many flowers stayed on the wall?

problem: How many tiles are in the kitchen floor pattern that Rami laid? He set 8 rows with 10 tiles in each.
follow_up_questions: Later he lifted 15 cracked tiles. How many tiles stayed in the floor?

problem: A toy train moves 15 centimetres along the track each second. How far does it go in 23 seconds?
follow_up_questions: The train then reverses for 9 seconds at the same speed. How far is it now from where it started?

problem: How many centimetres does Lin's toy frog travel in 23 hops, if every hop is 15 centimetres long?
follow_up_questions: It then makes 9 hops back towards the start. How far from the start is it now?

problem: On the farm trip, 8 hay wagons rolled out of the barn, and 3 children rode in each wagon. The path was dusty and steep. What was the number of children riding in the wagons?
How many skiers rode the chairlift? There were 8 chairs going up, with 3 skiers on each chair. Snow was falling softly.
At the book swap, 12 pupils each promise to bring 6 books. How many books should there be?
follow_up_questions: In the end, 9 extra books turned up as well. How many books arrived?

problem: How many cupcakes does the bake sale expect? Every baker was asked for 6 cupcakes, and 12 bakers said yes.
follow_up_questions: On the day, 9 extra cupcakes came in too. How many cupcakes arrived?

problem: Each of the 7 bags the scouts packed for their camping trip held 8 packets of noodles. How many noodle packets did they pack?
follow_up_questions: Each packet of noodles makes 4 bowls. How many bowls can be made?

problem: How many tins of beans went to the shelter? Volunteers filled 7 crates, each holding 8 tins.
follow_up_questions: Each tin of beans feeds 4 people. How many people can be fed?

problem: The toy factory ships 6 full crates today, and a crate holds 27 teddy bears. How many teddy bears leave the factory?
follow_up_questions: Each teddy bear wears 3 buttons. How many buttons are on the bears?

problem: How many apples are loaded onto the cart if the farmer fills 6 baskets with 27 apples in each?
follow_up_questions: Every apple is cut into 3 pieces for the school snack. How many pieces is that?

problem: The tennis coach keeps balls in nets, 10 balls to a net, and she has 9 full nets in the cupboard. How many tennis balls does she have?
follow_up_questions: In the first week of practice, 34 balls are lost over the fence. How many are left?
The rest are shared out among 7 coaches, the same number each. How many balls does each coach get?

problem: How many pencils does the classroom have, if the pencil drawer holds 9 boxes and each box contains 10 pencils?
follow_up_questions: During the first month, the pupils use up 34 pencils. How many are left?
The leftover pencils are put into 7 pots, with the same number in each. How many pencils go into each pot?

problem: At diving practice, 6 swimmers take turns on the high board, and every swimmer dives 5 times. What is the total number of dives?
follow_up_questions: To reach the board they climb a ladder with 10 steps, once for every dive. How many steps did they climb in total?
The next day, 4 of the swimmers dive the same number of times as before. How many dives is that?
How many dives did they do over the two days?

problem: How many times did the slide get used? At the playground, 6 children each went down the slide 5 times.
follow_up_questions: The slide ladder has 10 steps. How many steps did they climb in all?
The next afternoon, 4 of the children slide the same number of times as before. How many slides is that?
How many slides were there over the two afternoons?

problem: Each carton of diaries holds 12 diaries, and a bookshop with 4 staff orders 18 cartons for the new year. How many diaries does it order?
follow_up_questions: In January the shop sells 89 diaries. How many diaries are left?

problem: How many water bottles did the sports shop order? It ordered 18 boxes, each holding 12 bottles, and it has 4 tills.
follow_up_questions: During the summer the shop sells 89 bottles. How many bottles are left?

problem: Before lunch on the hottest day of summer, the beach kiosk sold 9 boxes of ice lollies, with 4 lollies in each box. How many lollies did it sell?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon it sold 8 more lollies. How many lollies did it sell in all?

problem: How many muffins did the school bake sale sell in the morning, if it sold 9 plates and each plate held 4 muffins?
follow_up_questions: Later it sold 8 more muffins. What is the total number of muffins sold?

problem: There is a pair of flip-flops by the pool for each of the 9 children in the swimming lesson. How many flip-flops are by the pool?
follow_up_questions: Then 4 more children each left a pair of flip-flops there. How many flip-flops are by the pool now?
When the lesson ended, 10 flip-flops were picked up. How many flip-flops were still there?

problem: How many gloves are on the radiator? After the snowball fight, 9 children each hung a pair of gloves there to dry.
follow_up_questions: Then 4 more children each hung up a pair of gloves. How many gloves are on the radiator now?
At home time, 10 gloves were taken. How many gloves were still on the radiator?

problem: The paper plane contest had 19 teams, and every team got 6 throws. The longest flight was 30 metres. What was the total number of throws?
follow_up_questions: One in every 6 throws ended in a crash. How many throws crashed?

problem: How many shots were taken at the archery day? Each of the 19 archers shot 6 arrows, and the target stood 30 metres away.
follow_up_questions: One in every 6 arrows missed the target. How many arrows missed?

problem: The town parade has 8 floats, and 4 balloons are tied to every float. The parade goes past the old church. How many balloons are on the floats?
follow_up_questions: Then 3 of the floats lose all their balloons in the wind. How many balloons are still on the floats?
The organisers want 50 balloons on the floats. How many more balloons would they need to reach that?

problem: How many candles are glowing on the tables? The restaurant has 8 tables, and each one has 4 candles. Soft music is playing.
follow_up_questions: A draught blows out all the candles on 3 tables. How many candles are still glowing?
The owner would like 50 candles glowing. How many more candles must glow to reach that?

problem: There are 12 pencils in each of the 6 tins in the art room. How many pencils are there in all the tins?
follow_up_questions: The pencils come in 2 kinds, red and blue, with the same number of each. How many red pencils are there?
Ilse borrows 8 red pencils for a project. How many red pencils are left in the tins?

problem: How many socks are in the drawer if Mum has put 6 bundles there, each with 12 socks?
follow_up_questions: The socks come in 2 colours, grey and white, with the same number of each. How many white socks are there?
Rohan takes 8 white socks for football camp. How many white socks are left in the drawer?

problem: Volunteers planted rose bushes in the town square in 5 rows of 7. How many rose bushes did they plant?
follow_up_questions: Each bush needs 2 sticks to hold it up. How many sticks do they use?

problem: How many fence posts did the farmer put in? He set them in 5 lines, with 7 posts in each line.
follow_up_questions: Each post needs 2 nails to hold the wire. How many nails does he use?

problem: How many books were donated to the book fair? They arrived in 3 crates, each holding 20 books.
follow_up_questions: The goal was 75 books. How many books short of the goal were they?

problem: The children filled 3 buckets with conkers, and each bucket held 20 conkers. What is the total number of conkers they gathered?
follow_up_questions: They had hoped for 75 conkers. How many short of that were they?

problem: Gardener Olga lines up seedling pots in a tray: 5 rows, and 6 pots in each row. She hums while she works. How many pots fit in the tray?
How many eggs fill one tray at the farm shop? A tray holds 5 rows of eggs, with 6 eggs in a row. The hens are kept in a big wooden barn.
For a whole week, a baker makes 9 apple pies every day with the help of her 2 apprentices. How many apple pies does she make that week?
follow_up_questions: The next week she bakes 4 fewer pies each day. How many pies does she bake in the second week?
How many pies did she bake over the two weeks?

problem: How many laps did Aisha swim in one week? She swam 9 laps every day for the whole week, in a pool with 2 diving boards.
follow_up_questions: The following week she swam 4 fewer laps each day. How many laps did she swim that week?
What is her total number of laps for the two weeks?

problem: Gardeners joined 8 pieces of garden hose, each 10 metres long, to make one long hose. How long is the joined hose?
follow_up_questions: The vegetable patch is 95 metres from the tap. How many more metres of hose do they need?

problem: How long is the rope the climbers tie together, if they join 8 ropes and each rope is 10 metres long?
follow_up_questions: The bottom of the cliff is 95 metres below. How many more metres of rope do they need?

problem: For 5 weeks of the holidays, Jakob swam at the pool 4 times each week. How many times did he go swimming?
follow_up_questions: Each time, he swam for 30 minutes. How many minutes did he swim altogether?
How many hours is that?
His cousin swam 3 hours less than Jakob over those weeks. How many hours did his cousin swim?

problem: How many piano lessons did Mai have, if she had 4 lessons a week for 5 weeks?
follow_up_questions: Every lesson lasted 30 minutes. How many minutes of lessons did she have?
How many hours of lessons is that?
Her friend had 3 fewer hours of lessons in those weeks. How many hours of lessons did her friend have?

problem: Every paper owl made in art class had 2 buttons for eyes, and 8 children each made one owl. How many buttons were used?
follow_up_questions: Each owl also had 5 feathers glued on. How many feathers were used?
How many buttons and feathers were used altogether?

problem: How many wheels did the toy carts need? The 8 children at woodwork club each built a cart, and every cart had 2 wheels.
follow_up_questions: Each cart also had 5 nails. How many nails were used?
Altogether, how many wheels and nails were used?

problem: Each of the 27 children at the summer camp folded 4 paper planes on a windy afternoon. How many planes did they fold?
follow_up_questions: The planes were launched in rounds of 9. How many rounds were there?
Each round lasted 3 minutes. How long did all the rounds take?

problem: How many sandcastles did the children build at the beach? There were 27 children, and each child built 4 castles.
follow_up_questions: A judge looked at the castles in groups of 9. How many groups did she look at?
She spent 3 minutes on each group. How many minutes did the judging take?

problem: Tickets for the science fair cost 2 dollars. Inside, 5 clocks stood on each of the 6 benches. How many clocks could visitors see?
follow_up_questions: Each clock had 3 batteries. How many batteries were in the clocks?
By the end of the fair, 18 batteries had run out. How many batteries still worked?
The working batteries were packed into boxes of 8. How many boxes were filled?

problem: How many toy cars were on display at the toy show? There were 6 shelves, each with 5 cars, and the show lasted 2 days.
follow_up_questions: Every toy car had 3 batteries. How many batteries were there?
When the show closed, 18 batteries were flat. How many still worked?
The good batteries were put into packs of 8. How many packs were filled?

problem: There are 28 children in the quiz club, and the leader gives each one a sheet with 15 riddles. She likes to use yellow paper. How many riddles does she hand out in total?
follow_up_questions: By the end of term, all but 37 of the riddles had been answered. How many riddles were answered?

problem: How many words must the spelling group learn? Each of the 28 pupils gets a list of 15 words. The lists are pinned on a corkboard.
follow_up_questions: By the end of term, the pupils had learned all but 37 of the words. How many words were learned?

problem: Balloons for the festival come 8 to a bag, with 6 bags in each carton. The party planner buys 4 cartons. How many balloons does she buy?
follow_up_questions: Each of the 24 children at the festival gets the same number of balloons. How many does each child get?

problem: How many crayons are there in 4 boxes, if each box has 6 packs and every pack holds 8 crayons?
follow_up_questions: The crayons are shared equally among 24 pupils. How many crayons does each pupil get?

problem: There were 13 groups at the litter pick, and every group filled 34 bags with rubbish. Everyone wore bright vests. How many bags were filled?
follow_up_questions: The bags are loaded onto pallets of 17. How many pallets are needed?
A truck can take 13 pallets on each trip. How many trips does the truck make?

problem: How many paper cups were collected? There were 13 stalls at the festival, and each stall collected 34 used cups. The cups were stacked neatly.
follow_up_questions: The cups are packed into boxes of 17. How many boxes are needed?
A cart carries 13 boxes at a time. How many trips does the cart make?

problem: The 9 pupils in the art club wanted to help the animal shelter, so every pupil brought 3 cans of pet food. What is the total number of cans?
follow_up_questions: Their teacher added 8 cans of her own. How many cans did they give to the shelter?

problem: How many books did the reading group donate to the hospital? Every one of its 9 members gave 3 books.
follow_up_questions: The librarian added 8 books too. How many books went to the hospital?

problem: Ms Lindgren needs cards for her thank-you notes, so she picks up 8 packs at the stationery shop. Every pack holds 5 cards. A cat is asleep by the till. How many cards does she buy?
follow_up_questions: She smudges 3 cards while writing. How many cards can she still use?
She puts 2 stickers on each of those cards. How many stickers does she use?

problem: How many tags does Arjun have for his gift boxes? He bought 8 strips of tags, and each strip has 5 tags. His shopping bag is blue.
follow_up_questions: He tears 3 tags by accident. How many tags can he still use?
He ties 2 ribbons to each of those tags. How many ribbons does he use?

problem: The sports shop has 50 socks in every box and 12 boxes in the storeroom. The boxes sit on a high shelf. How many socks does it have?
follow_up_questions: Socks are sold in pairs. How many pairs is that?
The shop sells 85 pairs in a month. How many pairs are left after that month?

problem: How many shoelaces does the shoe factory have? It has 12 crates of shoelaces, and every crate holds 50. The factory is next to the river.
follow_up_questions: Laces are packed in pairs. How many pairs of laces is that?
The factory ships 85 pairs in a week. How many pairs are left after that week?

problem: At the bouncy castle, the children are queuing in 4 rows, and every row has 6 children. How many children are in the queue?
How many hens are in the coop if the farmer counts 4 perches with 6 hens on each perch?
Greta spent Saturday watering gardens for her neighbours while they were away. Each of the 7 gardens took her 9 minutes. What was her total watering time, in minutes?
follow_up_questions: Each neighbour paid her 4 dollars. How much money did she earn?
She spent 15 dollars on a new kite. How much money did she have left?

problem: How many minutes did Tariq spend walking dogs on Saturday? He walked the dogs of 7 neighbours, and each walk lasted 9 minutes.
follow_up_questions: Each neighbour gave him 4 pounds. How much did he earn?
He bought a book for 15 pounds. How much money did he have left?

problem: At the community centre's puzzle afternoon, a puzzle with 48 pieces sat on every table, and there were 15 tables. A fan whirred in the corner. What was the total number of puzzle pieces?
follow_up_questions: By closing time, 9 of the puzzles were done. How many pieces were in the finished puzzles?
How many pieces were in the puzzles that were not finished?

problem: How many beads were on the craft tables? There were 15 tables at the bead club, and each table had a kit with 48 beads. Rain tapped on the windows.
follow_up_questions: By the end, 9 kits had been made into necklaces. How many beads were in the finished necklaces?
How many beads were in the kits that were not finished?

problem: At the youth club's film night on the grass, every rug had 3 children on it, and there were 7 rugs. How many children were on the rugs?
follow_up_questions: Each child brought 2 snacks. How many snacks were there?

problem: How many campers fit in the tents? The leader put up 7 tents, with room for 3 campers in each one.
follow_up_questions: Every camper brought a lamp that needs 2 batteries. How many batteries were there?

problem: Baby Nia loves stacking cups. Today she made 6 towers that were each 8 cups tall. How many cups did she use?
follow_up_questions: She knocks over 2 towers while giggling. How many cups are still in towers?
Her dad builds 4 shorter towers of equal height from the fallen cups. How many cups tall is each new tower?

problem: How many crates are stacked in the warehouse? A forklift has made 6 stacks, each 8 crates high.
follow_up_questions: It bumps 2 stacks and they fall. How many crates are still stacked?
The fallen crates are restacked into 4 shorter stacks of equal height. How many crates high is each new stack?

problem: In the garden, Ines picked 4 tomatoes from the first plant, 4 from the second, 4 from the third and 4 from the fourth. What is the total number of tomatoes she picked?
How many shells did Kofi find on his walk? There were 4 on the first beach, 4 on the second, 4 on the third and 4 on the last.
Each pile of twigs the campers gathered had 8 twigs, and they made 6 piles. Their tents are 12 metres from the lake. How many twigs did they gather?
follow_up_questions: They burned 30 twigs on the first evening. How many twigs were left?
Each evening after that they burned 6 twigs. For how many more evenings did the twigs last?

problem: How many logs did the family stack by the cabin? They made 6 piles of 8 logs each, after driving 12 kilometres up the mountain.
follow_up_questions: They burned 30 logs on the first night. How many logs were left?
Each night after that they burned 6 logs. For how many more nights did the logs last?

problem: How many old crayons did the class collect for melting down? They sorted them into 7 heaps of 10.
follow_up_questions: They kept 22 crayons for colouring. How many crayons were melted?
Every 8 old crayons made one new big crayon. How many new crayons were made?

problem: The class collected bottle tops for an art project and stacked them in 7 piles. Every pile had 10 tops. What is the total number of bottle tops?
follow_up_questions: They used 22 tops for a mosaic. How many tops were left?
The rest were glued onto boards, 8 tops per board. How many boards were made?

problem: On each Monday, the school bus drives to the swimming pool 5 times, carrying 9 children every time. How many children ride to the pool each Monday?
follow_up_questions: Each child brings 2 towels. How many towels is that?
How many children ride the bus to the pool over 3 Mondays?
If 40 of those children were girls, how many were boys?

problem: What is the number of boxes the delivery bike carries each Friday, if it makes 5 runs and takes 9 boxes on every run?
follow_up_questions: Each box holds 2 pizzas. How many pizzas is that?
How many boxes does the bike carry in 3 Fridays?
If 40 of those boxes went to offices, how many went to homes?

problem: Orange lockers line the gym changing room in 8 rows, and there are 7 lockers in every row. The paint is still fresh. How many lockers are there?
How many seats are in the small theatre? It has 8 rows, with 7 seats in each row. The curtains are made of red velvet.
There are 17 bike spaces in each of the 6 racks in the school bike shed. How many bike spaces are there?
follow_up_questions: In the morning, 88 bikes were parked there. How many spaces were free?

problem: How many boxes are on the shelves of the garage, if there are 5 shelves holding 12 boxes each?
follow_up_questions: Grandpa sorts 4 boxes every hour. How many hours does it take him to sort them all?

problem: How many scarves fit on the hooks? The market stall has 4 hooks, and each hook holds 9 scarves when it is full.

How many marbles do the children have altogether now?

problem: A dollhouse has 4 floors and 16 tiny windows, with the same number of windows on every floor. How many windows are on each floor?

problem: The hotel has 16 rooms in all, with the same number on each of its 4 corridors. Find the number of rooms on one corridor.

How many beads are on all 8 strings now?
